title: China needs U.S. dollars but is building a hedge against Washington’s sanctions
summary: China is increasingly reliant on U.S. dollars for its economic activities, yet it is simultaneously developing strategies to mitigate the impact of potential sanctions from Washington. The U.S. has the ability to exert pressure on Chinese banks regarding their dealings with Iran by leveraging access to its financial system. In response, Beijing is investing in alternatives like the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) to reduce its dependency on U.S. financial infrastructure.
shadowing: China is increasingly reliant on U.S. dollars.
